name: Extra System Reloaded - Oddisz Edition
author: Oddisz (after Extra System Reloaded by Originem, Iridescens and President Matt Damon)
description: Pour credits, materials and story points into the ships you love. Any friendly market with a spaceport has an Extra Systems bay: buy upgrade levels for durability, weapons, targeting, magazines, flux, shields or phase, ship systems, hangars, engines, logistics and combat readiness, raise a hull's quality at shipyards so every upgrade hits harder, and slot rare augments with unique combat effects. Only your ships are ever modified; enemy fleets never get any of it. Costs, strength, limits and slots are all in the LunaLib settings.
